title: GL-20 — Terraform workflow modules state import
stopChargesPanel: terraform destroy; remove .terraform and state files from disk (state gitignored).

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Terraform is required for the steps that follow. Use the fixture in lab-fixtures/gl-20.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Set lab variables
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.
Success: suffix is unique and lowercase-safe.

steps.title: Open fixture
bullets: Review main.tf for the S3 bucket and LabId=gl-20 tags.

steps.title: terraform init
bullets: Success: init completes with local backend.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: S3 bills per GB-month of storage and per request; a bucket holding one tiny object costs a fraction of a cent, but storage keeps billing until `terraform destroy` removes the bucket.
Same-hour estimate is pennies for a tiny bucket.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Run `terraform destroy -var bucket_suffix=$Suffix` after emptying if needed.
Remove .terraform local state artifacts from disk; state stays gitignored.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run destroy and verify bucket gone with aws s3api head-bucket.
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-20 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: Leftover S3 storage can still bill until `terraform destroy` removes the bucket.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-20 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-20 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-20. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Local Terraform backend: init, fmt, validate, plan, apply, state list, destroy on gl-20 fixture. You run apply/destroy.
